--prefix=/opt/qonic
--target-os=mingw32
--arch=x86_64
--cross-prefix=x86_64-w64-mingw32-
--cc=x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc-win32
--cxx=x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++-win32
--pkg-config=pkg-config
--pkg-config-flags=--static
--enable-cross-compile
--enable-gpl
--enable-version3
--disable-nonfree
--disable-network
--disable-autodetect
--disable-debug
--disable-doc
--disable-everything
--enable-ffmpeg
--enable-ffprobe
--enable-avcodec
--enable-avformat
--enable-avfilter
--enable-swresample
--enable-swscale
--enable-avdevice
--enable-w32threads
--enable-zlib
--enable-libmp3lame
--enable-libvorbis
--enable-libopus
--enable-librubberband
--enable-protocol=file,pipe
--enable-indev=lavfi
--enable-demuxer=mp3,flac,wav,mov,aac,ogg,ape,aiff,asf
--enable-muxer=mp3,flac,wav,adts,ipod,ogg,null,pcm_s16le
--enable-decoder=mp3,mp3float,flac,pcm_s16le,pcm_s16be,pcm_s24le,pcm_s24be,pcm_s32le,pcm_s32be,pcm_f32le,pcm_f64le,aac,vorbis,opus,ape,alac,wmav1,wmav2,wmapro,wmalossless,mjpeg,png
--enable-encoder=libmp3lame,flac,pcm_s16le,aac,libvorbis,libopus
--enable-parser=aac,mpegaudio,opus,vorbis
--enable-filter=aresample,asetrate,atempo,rubberband,sine,aformat,anull
--enable-bsf=null
--extra-cflags=-O2 -fno-ident -ffile-prefix-map=/repo=/usr/src/qonic
--extra-cxxflags=-O2 -fno-ident -ffile-prefix-map=/repo=/usr/src/qonic
--extra-ldflags=-static -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++
